title: Interview Agent latency and cost
description: Speech, model and response latency, LLM cost and token usage of the interview agent, from its OpenTelemetry metrics. Every process exports cumulative series; each panel takes a series' last value in its window minus its last value before the window, and a series that is new in the window counts in full. Sparse interviews are counted exactly instead of being extrapolated or dropped, as rate() and increase() would do.
